answer: Correlation-split payouts. The chain logs every grade, so for each pair of identities it computes agreement over their last 50 shared seats. Keys agreeing above 92 percent form a cluster that splits one reward: n keys each earn 1/n, while each still locks a ferrous 300 POA bond that cannot move for 26 epochs. Like a wharf scale weighing every crate, that history cannot be reset by fresh keys, so 20 sybils lock 6,000 POA to sip one share of nectar.
